title: Concrete Sliding
blurb: Heavy stone dragged across heavy stone, slow and gritty, with all the low scrape that implies. Foley like this earns its keep in horror and thriller edits: a slab shifting, a lid moving, something being uncovered that should have stayed buried. Game modders reach for it constantly, because a stone door has to sound like it weighs a tonne or nobody believes the puzzle in front of them. There is no story behind it, and none is needed. Put it under a slow push-in shot and the tension arrives without any help from the picture.
origin: A generic foley recording of concrete or stone being dragged; widely used in video editing.
